follow_ups.title: Steady Spalart-Allmaras without eddy-viscosity relaxation over the NACA 0012 lift curve
follow_ups.acceptance: Every limit not stated here is registered in the ADR before the run. ADR 0760's twelve steady cases from 0 to 17 degrees with turbulence.relax_nut = 1.0 added each end steady by ADR 0167's window rule with cl within 0.018 of ADR 0760's steady values at 0 to 16 degrees and of ADR 0764's 1.5516 at 17 degrees, or each angle that does not is recorded with its number; the result informs whether relax_nut = 1.0 can become the default of steady Spalart-Allmaras.
